I'm really looking forward to going on a weekend trip along the coast and I think your Tindall would be perfect for it - it's been years since I've driven one and I'm excited to get back behind the wheel. It would be sometime in June 2027, we're still finalising the exact dates. We'll be picking it up from your garage, so no need to worry about delivery. I've attached my driving licence for your records. Let me know if that sounds good to you.

Best regards,
